description: Controls for the incoming song, with entry and continuation positions and an optional high-pass sweep.

start.description: Position in the incoming song in seconds where it starts at the transition beginning.

continueFrom.description: Position in the incoming song in seconds where normal playback continues after the overlap. Consistent with the integral of its speed curve, allowing for numeric rounding.

highpassHz.description: Optional high-pass corner frequencies in Hz, replacing the incoming low shelf. Same sample count as every other curve. Omit when unused; do not return null.
